BrochureContent.Content:
1 Glenview is a superb detached family home extending to approximately 230 sq.m., ideally positioned within easy walking distance of Enniskerry Village.

Set within a quiet cul-de-sac development of just nine homes, the property enjoys a peaceful and private setting while remaining close to all local amenities.
The accommodation is bright, spacious, and well-balanced throughout. On the ground floor, an inviting entrance hallway welcomes you into the home and sets the tone for the quality within. There are two well-proportioned sitting rooms, both featuring wood-burning stoves, creating warm and comfortable spaces ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. To the rear, a superb open-plan kitchen, living and dining area forms the heart of the home, with direct access to the garden. A separate utility room, complete with its own external door, adds to the practicality of the layout, while a guest W/C completes the ground floor accommodation.
Upstairs, the property comprises four generous double bedrooms, two of which are en-suite. The impressive master suite is a standout feature, boasting a walk-in wardrobe and private en-suite, offering a luxurious and private retreat.
Externally, the property is equally impressive. To the rear lies a large, private garden, offering excellent space for outdoor living and entertaining. To the front, the home is set behind electric gates and approached by a large, landscaped driveway, providing ample off-street parking for multiple vehicles. The setting offers a strong sense of privacy while still being within walking distance of the village.
Additional features include solar panels and a B3 energy rating, ensuring improved energy efficiency and reduced running costs.
Enniskerry Village, located at the foothills of the Wicklow Mountains, is renowned for its picturesque setting and strong sense of community. A short stroll from the property brings you to an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, shops, and local amenities, as well as renowned attractions such as Powerscourt Estate and Gardens. The area is particularly well regarded for families, with access to a number of excellent primary and secondary schools nearby.
The location also offers superb connectivity, with easy access to the M50 and N11, while Bray is just a short drive away, providing DART services. Dublin Bus routes also serve the area, making city commuting straightforward.

Key Features
• Detached 4-bedroom family home (c. 230 sq.m.)
• Quiet cul-de-sac of just 9 houses
• Walking distance to Enniskerry Village
• Four double bedrooms
• Two en-suite bedrooms
• Impressive master suite with walk-in wardrobe
• Two sitting rooms with wood-burning stoves
• Large open-plan kitchen / living / dining area
• Guest W/C
• Utility room with external access
• Solar panels & B3 BER rating
• Large private rear garden
• Landscaped driveway with parking for multiple cars
• Electric gates
• Easy access to M50, N11 and Dublin City
